name: Modbus Client → Read Input Registers
description: Reads one or more input registers (function code `0x04`).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The device address the frame is sent to. Accepts `0`-`255`; the valid Modbus device range is `1`-`247`, and `0` is broadcast (no reply will ever arrive; see [Behavior](https://esphome.io/components/modbus_client#behavior)).

config_entries.label: Modbus ID
config_entries.description: The Modbus hub to send on. Automatically assigned when a single hub is configured.
